Stock-based; Company Common Shares convert into 0.1400 Parent Common Shares per share (the Company Share Merger Consideration), plus cash in lieu of fractional shares and dividends on the Parent Common Shares; Company Preferred Shares convert into one Parent Preferred Share per share (the Company Preferred Share Consideration), with dividends on such Parent Shares; no CVRs are indicated.
Company Common Shares: 0.1400 Parent Common Shares per Company Common Share (Exchange Ratio) plus cash in lieu of fractional Parent Common Shares and any dividends or other distributions payable on Parent Common Shares. Company Preferred Shares: one Parent Preferred Share per Company Preferred Share (Company Preferred Share Consideration) plus any dividends or other distributions payable on Parent Shares. Partnership Units: Partnership Unit Merger Consideration consists of New Parent OP Units issued to Partnership OP Unit holders at the Exchange Ratio (for Non-Elected Units), and cash in lieu of the Partnership Unit Merger Consideration for Non-Accredited Investor Units (cash equal to Parent Common Share Price × 0.1400).
0.1400 Parent Common Shares per Company Common Share (Exchange Ratio), subject to adjustment pursuant to Section 2.1(b) and Sections 5.11(c)–(d); plus cash in lieu of fractional Parent Common Shares under Section 2.6 and any dividends or distributions payable in respect of Parent Common Shares under Section 2.3(e).
